about.label: About Us
about.heading: You are implementing high-value projects. But how do you truly differentiate from competitors?
about.intro: Artify unifies engineering consulting, bespoke fabrication, smart microclimate systems, and professional masterclasses to deliver lasting, tangible value for construction developments.
about.ubTitle: What does luxury mean in Ulaanbaatar?
about.ubIntro: In Ulaanbaatar, the world's coldest capital, there are many problems we have grown used to in our daily lives.
ubPoints: It gets cold near the window.
Walking barefoot on the floor feels freezing.
Opening a window lets in noise and air pollution.
Even after 8 hours of sleep, you wake up tired.
Even interior finishing materials can affect our health.
about.ubBold: Artify sees these not as separate issues, but as one holistic environmental problem.
about.ubBody: For us, true luxury is not only about appearance — it is the opportunity to live in an environment free of noise pollution, with clean air, even warmth, proper humidity, health, and energy efficiency.
about.smartBody1: At a time when the risk of global energy scarcity is rising, Artify offers the most advanced, efficient, cost-effective, self-sufficient solutions based on renewable energy sources.
about.smartBody2: This makes it possible not only to implement self-sufficient projects in remote areas lacking infrastructure, but also to contribute to reducing national energy consumption and Ulaanbaatar's air pollution.
about.solutionBody: Connecting these five elements through science, engineering, technology, and design to craft the quality of human life is Artify's core philosophy.
about.partnerBody1: By partnering with Artify, you gain access to the construction industry's leading expertise, technology, and business ecosystem.
about.partnerBody2: We work with partners such as TechInvent LLC, the official distributor of Zehnder; erxes Inc., Mongolia's top technology company recognized in Silicon Valley; and Block.mn, the unified platform for the construction industry.
about.closing: We aim for more than constructing buildings. We craft the quality of the environments people live in.

ceo.label: CEO Introduction
ceo.quote: The construction industry is a multidimensional space where knowledge, technology, and craftsmanship from diverse disciplines converge. Artify aspires to be the premier platform where the industry's finest come together.

contact.faq1Q: How quickly can I receive a project consultation?
contact.faq1A: Our engineering advisory team reviews all inquiries and responds with initial feedback within 24 hours.
contact.faq2Q: Do you provide on-site engineering assessments in Ulaanbaatar?
contact.faq2A: Yes, our certified civil engineers conduct on-site thermal, acoustic, and ventilation audits for residential and commercial developments.
contact.faq3Q: How do you partner with international manufacturers like Zehnder?
contact.faq3A: We are the official system integrators and technology partners for Swiss-made Zehnder ventilation systems and cutting-edge building materials.
contact.faq4Q: How can I enroll our construction crew into Block Academy?
contact.faq4A: Select Masterclass in the contact form or visit our dedicated academy channels to register for certified workforce modules.
